_note: Constants of a1_shroud_twin.py (stages source, geno), kept as DATA with class and provenance per the validation numeric ratchet (R28).

gas.note: Migdal 1972 / GENO thermo_air14: gamma 1.4, M 28.97 (R 287.0); GENO's p0 1e5 Pa (IO_m: ps in bar) and T0 300 K (T 206.90 K at M 1.5 in the field) -- T0 is POSED at 3800 K because the program's tables span 1050-3900 K (a1_ideal_march_jax.T_TAB_LO/HI; a cold case clamps, measured 2026-09-24): for a calorically perfect gas the Mach field, p/p0 and C_F are T0- and p0-independent; inlet Mach 1.5 = GENO's uniform start line

channel.note: the exact two-ray channel of stage source: top ray 22 deg above the oracle's 12-deg plug ray, lip at 60 percent of the marched length (so that F's C- and the after-lip mode are exercised), coarse/fine grids for the Richardson bands, shroud stations = half the plug stations (at least 8), the rejector curves the shroud by 2 percent at the lip

geno.note: stage geno defaults: fine grid (280, 61) with the coarse at half -- (140, 31) alone leaves the Richardson bands an order too loose (measured 2026-09-24: coarse (70,16) wall-pressure error 0.26); the R-3 rejector lifts the shroud by 3 percent (ramped from the start: +0.04 in area ratio, dM_e ~ 0.09, against a 1-percent lift's 0.03 that a loose band absorbed); TW-2 asks >= 90 percent of stations inside their Richardson band; a rejector must exceed 10 x the clean error; 40 wall samples for the cross-code pressure reading; ref_class = the reference's own resolution as read on OUR mesh: the max |M - M_e| and |theta| on F's C- at (140,31) change from GENO NI 50 to NI 1001 by 0.011 / 1.1e-3 and the NI-1001 reading itself is 0.013 / 2.3e-3 (eps 6, 2026-09-24) -- the exit-uniformity checks are graded against K_RICH x our move PLUS this class (a deviation that stalls under our refinement is the walls'); wedge_rows_per_station: the wedge is thinned so that its columns' launch spacing along the start line matches ~1 plug station spacing projected along the C+ (wedge_every = round(dy_row_launch / dy_row))

solver.note: brentq brackets for q(M) in units of a* (supersonic branch of the tables) and for M(A/A*), tolerances, and the floor under a band that would otherwise be exactly zero
